newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX SIGN SIBON AS REPLACEMENT FOR KLUIVERT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX SIGN SIBON AS REPLACEMENT FOR KLUIVERT.

text.p: Dutch champions Ajax Amsterdam have signed Roda JC Kerkrade striker Gerald Sibon on a five year contract, Dutch news agency ANP said on Friday.
Sibon, who turns 23 on Saturday, will start with Ajax next season and is viewed as a replacement for Patrick Kluivert who is moving to AC Milan.
Sibon's transfer fee is believed to be around five million guilders ($2.6 million).

Sibon is in his first season at the Kerkrade side and was on a four-year contract. He has scored 11 times in the Dutch first division and on Wednesday netted the only goal against Willem II Tilburg which put Roda in the Dutch Cup final.
